clips.title: The story
paras: In Teldrassil, Wellspring River carries fresh water north from Wellspring Lake before plunging to the ocean below. Its banks have grown dangerous as the timberlings turn hostile.

Wellspring River runs north from Wellspring Lake through Teldrassil's forest before falling from the great tree into the sea below. Its banks are no longer safe. The timberlings living there have grown crazed and attack travelers and druids who come near the water.
